notes.title: Update v1.6.8
notes.content:
Fix teleport requirement:
After you get ID Note item, if the next floor have other requirement (Level, Other item...), you still see options "Go to the next floor", now you need to have that item or reach that level in order to choose that option, or else it won't show up.

notes.title: Update v1.6.7
notes.content:
We release a new update for teleport device
Now you don't need to manually enter id for next floor!
If you have "Id note" for next floor in your inventory, when you interact with Teleport device, there will be choice options "Go to the next floor", select this choice will teleport you to next floor without input anything!
Example: If you are on floor 1, and you have item "Floor 2 ID Note" in your inventory, when you interact with Teleport Device, you can choose "Go to the next floor" like image below

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508414/40fa34f8e92bb2ea1f0d2bf157e0d38e51b940ae.png[/img]
